name: Unified GetEvents for Fabric RTI
description: Building a unified GetEvents experience across Fabric Real-Time Intelligence (RTI), ensuring consistency across Eventstream, Real-Time Hub, KQL/Eventhouse, Activator, Notebook, and Lakehouse. No more jumping between different wizards or piecing together workflows. With one streamlined flow, you can connect a source, preview your data, map your schema, and land it directly into any RTI destination — all in a few guided steps.Key capabilities:- One consistent ingestion experience across every RTI workload- Built-in data preview to validate events before ingestion- Schema inference and table mapping- Native integration with Eventstream, Eventhouse, Activator, Lakehouse, and Notebook

result.descriptionEs: Una única experiencia de ingesta coherente en Eventstream, Real-Time Hub, KQL/Eventhouse, Activator, Notebook y Lakehouse: conecta un origen, previsualiza los datos, asigna el esquema y llévalos a cualquier destino de RTI en pocos pasos guiados, con inferencia de esquema y vista previa integrada.
